# Zion Advisor
﻿# Zion Advisor

> Zion Advisor is a senior-led financial due diligence (FDD) boutique for Nordic M&A. We build QoE analyses, working capital (NWC peg) analyses and M&A databooks directly from Swedish SIE4 and Norwegian SAF-T accounting files, bridge K2/K3 and NGAAP to IFRS, and deliver a first-cut databook in 48-72 hours with senior review. Founder: Abhishek Bhandari. Based in Gurugram, India; focus on Sweden, Norway, Denmark and Finland.

## Services
- [Financial due diligence](https://www.zionadvisor.com/services/financial-due-diligence/): buy-side and sell-side FDD and QoE
- [M&A databooks](https://www.zionadvisor.com/services/ma-databooks/): audit-ready databooks, also for the Nordics
- [Working capital](https://www.zionadvisor.com/services/working-capital/): NWC and peg analysis
- [Vendor assistance](https://www.zionadvisor.com/services/vendor-assistance/)
- [Carve-out and separation](https://www.zionadvisor.com/services/carve-out-separation/)
- [SPA and closing advisory](https://www.zionadvisor.com/services/spa-closing-advisory/)
- [Valuations](https://www.zionadvisor.com/services/valuations/)
